safe_workspace_rule: All generated files should stay inside the repository/project folder unless the user explicitly approves another location.

command_policy.rtk_policy: Use RTK only when it is detected and stable. If RTK/helper setup fails, fallback to direct Python without asking the user to debug RTK.
command_policy.shell_policy: Do not rely on chained shell syntax. Run commands as separate script steps.
command_policy.render_policy: Render QA is optional unless final layout acceptance is required. If LibreOffice/soffice is unavailable, run structural DOCX QA and report render unavailable.

nontechnical_modes.discover: Read project folder and report what exists.
nontechnical_modes.pre-survey: Prepare or validate the project before survey generation.
nontechnical_modes.survey-analysis: Analyse returned survey results and update QA evidence.
nontechnical_modes.final: Run artifact gate, builders when configured, and final QA.
